title: Weekly in Tech: AI Is Becoming Infrastructure | Sep 1, 2026
description:
Five sourced technology signals in 55 seconds.

1. OpenAI says ChatGPT Ads reached a $1B annualized run rate.
2. AWS and NVIDIA plan 2 million additional GPUs for 2027–28.
3. Google says Gemma passed 1 billion downloads.
4. MIT reports CrysVCD reached high lattice-dynamics stability in nearly 70% of computational material generations.
5. OpenAI and Hugging Face published security findings.
